scope: bounded independent source/local-runtime review; report/probes only; no implementation edits or integration merge
verdict: No new defect demonstrated within reviewed scope; not whole-application approval or full security audit

unresolved_conditions.classification: conditional deployment assumption; no demonstrated vulnerability
unresolved_conditions.condition: Private stable root and immutable generations; Lstat/Open is not atomic no-follow; mutex/filesystem metadata resolution is not covered by later fetch timeout
unresolved_conditions.evidence: source inspection only; no API-controlled writer or boundary crossing demonstrated
unresolved_conditions.safe_followup: Verify chosen volume writer/ACL and slow-storage behavior; descriptor-relative/no-follow hardening only if untrusted concurrent writers are in scope

tradeoffs: One latest multi-instrument method request is generation coherent; separate history calls can select different generations
Old-generation flights consume shared configured capacity; new generation can fail unavailable until timeout/release
Metadata view reuse is not in-place archive tamper detection
Pinned views do not lease old generation files beyond existing retention grace
Optional future history adapters must expose HistoryProvider on upstream and pinned view
Pointer read adds hot-hit overhead; synthetic benchmark is not production throughput
